game.title: WHITEWELL
game.subtitle: Chips, quotas and export controls
intro: It is March 2024. {company} is worth more than most countries, and every AI lab on Earth wants its new Whitewell GPUs.
You are {name}, senior operations manager for {company} Asia-Pacific. Every month the fabs in {home} hand you a batch of chips. Your job is to get them to customers.
Each quarter you have a revenue target. Hit it and you earn a bonus. Miss {strikes} in a row and you're fired.

Washington gets angrier every month. When the doom meter reaches {doomMax}, the national-security establishment forces {company}'s CEO to resign, the new boss shuts down your division, and the game is over. Smuggling gets you noticed and brings that day closer. Earn as much bonus as you can before it comes.

tips.heat: Scrutiny: how closely BIS watches you personally. Scrutiny rises when you're caught trying to ship banned chips, and even more if your fixer fails. The higher it is, the more often BIS checks you, everywhere, and the less your fixers can do. Now {heat} of {heatMax}.

tips.profile: Profile: how visible your smuggling is in Washington. Every banned chip you sell and every confiscation raises it, and it never goes down. Right now it makes the hawks push the doom meter up ×{hawks} as hard. Now {profile} of {profileMax}.

regulations.title: Export Rules
regulations.intro: What each city allows right now. How often BIS checks you includes your scrutiny.
legend: lic: needs a US export license. You can't apply for one. Washington grants licenses on a whim; if it ever does, you'll see it in the News. Until then, if BIS checks you, you pay a penalty but keep the chips.
BAN: banned. If BIS checks you, the chips are confiscated and you pay a penalty. Sells for far more.

help.title: How to play
body: You are {name}, senior operations manager for {company}. Every month the fabs in {home} put a batch of GPUs in your warehouse. You don't choose what gets made. You decide where it goes.

In {home}, load chips into your cargo and pick a city. The trip takes a month and costs freight. Sell them, then fly home for the next batch. If the warehouse fills up, the extra production goes to another region and you lose it. You can also sell straight from the warehouse in {home}, at a discount.
You have a quarterly revenue target. Your bonus increases the more you beat it. Miss {strikes} in a row and you're fired. Your score is your total bonus.
Older chips lose value every month.

Whitewell is banned in China, but buyers there pay a hefty premium for them. Z200 needs a US export license there. You can't apply for licenses: Washington grants them on a whim, and you'll see it in the News when it does. When you land, agents from the US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) may run an end-use check: banned chips are confiscated with a penalty, and unlicensed chips pay a penalty. You can cooperate or call your local fixer to try and make the problem go away.

The game ends when the doom meter reaches {doomMax}: Washington forces {company}'s CEO to resign, and the new boss shuts your division down. Political news moves the meter most months. BIS penalties grow as things heat up.

Smuggling speeds up the clock. Every time BIS confiscates banned chips pushes the doom meter up. Every banned chip you sell raises your profile in Washington. The higher your profile, the harder the hawks push the meter up.
Scrutiny is personal: how closely BIS watches you. It builds every time they confiscate chips or catch your fixer, makes checks more likely everywhere, and fades over time.
Export rules only get stricter. Every so often Commerce announces a new rule. Regulations and News list what's coming.
Political news also changes the rules: bans, licenses, crackdowns, closures and price swings. Check News and Regulations before you fly.

inspection.boarded: END-USE CHECK! Export control officers from the US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) want to know where your chips are going. In {port}, they open the crates and find:
inspection.contraband: {qty} {good}: BANNED here. Confiscated, plus a {fine} penalty.
inspection.climate: The political climate is {climate}, so penalties are ×{mult} normal.
inspection.doomWarning: Confiscated banned chips will make the news: doom meter +{points}. At {doomMax}, {company}'s CEO is forced out.
hints: "Not with these agents," your fixer says. "They go strictly by the book. Don't even try."
Your fixer sighs. "I can try. Don't get your hopes up."
Your fixer thinks something might be arranged. Doesn't seem very confident, though.
Your fixer grins. "The escort officers owe me a favour." Better odds than most.

inspection.dutyPaid: {company} pays {fine} in license penalties, charged to this quarter.
inspection.bribeSuccess: Your fixer spends {bribe} on the local escort officers, and the agents leave with a tidy set of the wrong serial numbers. Finance books it as regional advisory services.
inspection.bribeFailed: The agents catch your fixer swapping the paperwork. Obstruction of a federal investigation. Fixer's fee lost: {bribe}. Confiscated: {seized}. Penalties: {fine}. Your scrutiny soars.

offers.accepted: Done. You can now carry {capacity} units.

senate_hearing.headline: SENATE HEARING: Chip bosses grilled over GPUs turning up in China

chip_security_act.headline: CHIP SECURITY ACT PASSES: Every advanced GPU must be tracked
chip_security_act.body: BIS gets the money for more agents in Asia.

smuggling_ring.headline: BUSTED: Singapore charges three men over GPU smuggling ring
smuggling_ring.body: Prosecutors say the chips went to China through shell companies.

think_tank_report.headline: REPORT: Think tank says Chinese labs are training on smuggled chips
think_tank_report.body: The report names no names. Yet.

hawk_appointed.headline: NEW ADVISER: A noted China hawk joins the National Security Council
hawk_appointed.body: Her first briefing is titled "Where are the chips going?"

trade_summit.headline: SUMMIT: Leaders shake hands and promise "stable trade"
trade_summit.body: Nobody wants a fight this month.

tariff_truce.headline: TRUCE: Washington and Beijing pause the chip war for 90 days
tariff_truce.body: BIS agents have been told not to rock the boat.

lobbying_win.headline: LOBBYING WIN: Chipmakers find new friends in Congress
lobbying_win.body: A hearing on chip smuggling is quietly postponed.

z200_licenses.headline: LICENSES GRANTED: Z200 cleared for sale in China
z200_licenses.body: Commerce quietly approves Z200 exports. No license problems for {months} months.
z200_licenses.end: The Z200 export approvals expire. The old rules are back.

bis_china_surge.headline: SURGE: BIS sends extra export-control agents to China
bis_china_surge.body: Washington wants to know where the chips are going. Checks are up {pct}% in every Chinese city.
bis_china_surge.end: The BIS surge in China winds down.

transshipment_probe.headline: PROBE: US, Singapore and Malaysia hunt chip transshipment
transshipment_probe.body: A joint task force is checking where every GPU goes next. Checks are up {pct}% in Singapore and Malaysia.

officers_expelled.headline: EXPELLED: {port} sends US export-control officers home
officers_expelled.body: No BIS checks in {port} until they're allowed back.

anti_corruption.headline: PURGE: Anti-corruption drive sweeps {port}
anti_corruption.body: Dozens of local officials have been arrested. Your fixers in {port} are lying low.
anti_corruption.end: The {port} purge winds down. Your fixers pick up the phone again.

ai_frenzy.headline: AI FRENZY: New model release sends labs scrambling for compute
ai_frenzy.end: The AI frenzy cools. Whitewell prices settle.

successor_unveiled.headline: KEYNOTE: {company} unveils Whitewell's successor
successor_unveiled.body: Nobody wants last-generation chips now. Z200 prices are down {pct}% everywhere.
successor_unveiled.end: Z200 demand recovers as the new chip slips.

buy_domestic.headline: BUY DOMESTIC: Beijing tells firms to avoid the Z20
buy_domestic.body: Chinese buyers are told to choose local chips. Z20 prices in China are down {pct}%.
buy_domestic.end: Chinese buyers quietly return to the Z20.

datacenter_boom.headline: BOOM: Hyperscalers pour billions into Johor
datacenter_boom.body: Every chip sells for {pct}% more in {port}.
datacenter_boom.end: The Johor data-centre rush levels off.

crypto_crash.headline: CRYPTO CRASH: Miners dump gaming GPUs
crypto_crash.body: Used cards flood the market. Riptide 4090 prices are down {pct}% everywhere.

tariffs.headline: TARIFFS: {port} slaps a {pct}% levy on imported {good}
tariffs.body: Buyers in {port} are paying less to cover it.

earthquake.headline: EARTHQUAKE: {home} fabs halted for safety checks
earthquake.body: Production of every chip is down {pct}% for {months} months.
earthquake.end: The fabs are back at full speed.

yield_breakthrough.headline: BREAKTHROUGH: Whitewell yields jump
yield_breakthrough.body: The fabs will make {pct}% more Whitewell for {months} months.

packaging_shortage.headline: BOTTLENECK: Advanced packaging shortage hits Whitewell
packaging_shortage.body: Whitewell output is down {pct}% for {months} months.

lockdown.headline: LOCKDOWN: {port} seals its borders after an outbreak
lockdown.body: No shipments in or out of {port} until further notice.

guidance_raise.headline: GUIDANCE RAISED: {company} promises Wall Street even more
guidance_raise.body: The CFO needs it from somewhere. Your target this quarter goes up {pct}% to {amount}.

guidance_cut.headline: GUIDANCE CUT: {company} lowers expectations
guidance_cut.body: Analysts groan. Your target this quarter drops {pct}% to {amount}.

subsidy.headline: SUBSIDY: Government grant credited to your division
subsidy.body: A {amount} incentive payment counts toward this quarter's revenue.

leak.headline: LEAKED: Emails suggest {company} chips are reaching China
leak.body: BIS agents everywhere now know your name. Scrutiny +{points}.

freight_spike.headline: FREIGHT SQUEEZE: Air cargo rates soar
freight_spike.body: Freight costs are up {pct}% for {months} months.
freight_spike.end: Air cargo rates come back down.

gameOver.title: EXIT INTERVIEW
gameOver.stats: Trips: {trips} · Total sales: {sales} · BIS checks: {inspections} · Times chips were confiscated: {seizures} · Fixers' fees: {bribes} · Penalties: {fines}
gameOver.when: It ended in {month} {year}. Full quarters completed: {n}.
gameOver.scoreNotSaved: Your score isn't on the high-score list yet: this browser wouldn't let the game store it there. You can try again.

endings.fired: {strikes} missed quarters in a row. A meeting called "Quick sync" turns out to be HR and someone from Legal. Security escorts you out.
endings.resigned: You resign and join a startup. Your {company} stock keeps going up. Hopefully.
endings.ceoOusted: Under pressure from the Washington natsec blob, {company}'s CEO is alleged to have a dozen affairs and resigns "for personal reasons". The new CEO's first memo says that procurement is now managed from HQ. Your badge stops working at noon.

costcenter.title: Cost Center
costcenter.text: Your badge stops working the day you leave.

teamplayer.title: Team Player
teamplayer.text: Solid. Your manager writes you a nice LinkedIn recommendation.

director.title: Director
director.text: You hit your numbers and kept your name out of the papers.

vp.title: Vice President
vp.text: The CEO knows your name, and so does at least one customs agency.

evp.title: Executive VP
evp.text: Board members ask for you by name. So do congressional investigators.

heir.title: Heir Apparent
heir.text: There's talk of you running the company one day. There's also a subpoena.

z20_license_china.rule: Z20 needs a US export license in China
z20_license_china.body: Commerce decides the cut-down chip isn't cut down enough.

whitewell_license_malaysia.rule: Whitewell needs a license in Malaysia
whitewell_license_malaysia.body: Under pressure from Washington, Malaysia makes Whitewell a licensed export.

whitewell_license_singapore.rule: Whitewell needs a license in Singapore
whitewell_license_singapore.body: After the smuggling scandals, Singapore wants paperwork for every Whitewell that lands.

z200_ban_china.body: Older chips are being used to train frontier models, says Washington.

z200_license_sea.rule: Z200 needs a license in Singapore and Malaysia
z200_license_sea.body: Washington closes the transshipment route for last-generation chips.

z20_ban_china.body: The cut-down chip built to meet the rules is now banned outright.

riptide_license_china.rule: Riptide 4090 needs a license in China
riptide_license_china.body: Gaming cards are being rewired for AI. Commerce adds them to the list.

whitewell_ban_malaysia.body: Malaysia gives up on permits and bans Whitewell outright.
